versions.name: Camp Makualla
versions.summary: A Pacific Crest Council camp on the shore of Crescent Lake high in the Cascades of central Oregon, with campsites, A-frame shelters, and a dining hall, set near extensive backcountry and high-adventure country.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Pacific Crest Council camping page. The scout-camp-map 'Blue Mountain Council' label is wrong: Camp Makualla is a Pacific Crest Council property. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's camping page; classified conservatively as a weekend/unit camping property; features unsurveyed.
